'''Ibellia Ran's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. He had a daughter named [[Ibellia Ran]] from an Imperial [[Ibellia Ran's mother|slave]], who became a free citizen of the Empire.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ibellia Ran's father is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']].
